findings.what: External GitHub anchors (ShaLink githubHref, Footer repoHref) still carry no rel="noreferrer". Carried over from A4/S1.
findings.why: W2: external links carry rel=noreferrer. Hygiene only. The href is the fixed REPO constant plus /commit/ plus the sha, there is no target=_blank, and a javascript: scheme can't get in.

findings.what: The CSP keeps default-src 'self', but style-src allows 'unsafe-inline' and base-uri, form-action and object-src are not set. Carried over from A4/S3.
findings.why: W3 hardening only. No third-party origin is loaded, and script and fonts are self-hosted. Adding base-uri 'self', form-action 'none' and object-src 'none' is cheap.

findings.what: The activity chunk path is built from a DAG's plan_id and node id, which are not format-validated. A '..' segment would write outside src/web/public.
findings.why: W5 and DATA-6: the compiler should write only trace.json and its chunks. The input is the repo's own reviewed docs and git, not external data, so this is hardening. Restrict ids to [A-Za-z0-9._-] and refuse '..'.

notes: Previous round A4 S2 (trailer values go into trace.json unscanned) is fixed at head. src/web/compiler/index.ts:119 now runs isHit over the commit subject and every trailer value. A hit fails the compile naming only the commit's short SHA, never the matched text. The new test is DATA-5 A4/I3 and the fix gate (gate.fix) is green.

The A4/I1 and A4/I6 fix is that the compiler keeps the node attempt, and events, verdicts and findings stay empty (U1 and U3 own them). Status is null, not a default. Loop.jsonl and verdict files are only read through the denylist scan. That adds no output and so no leak surface.

W1: grep for dangerouslySetInnerHTML, innerHTML, outerHTML, insertAdjacentHTML, document.write, eval( and new Function over src/web found only a comment in MarkdownText.tsx. Activity raw, command and file render as React text nodes. Met.

W2: the Activity commit link is REPO plus /commit/ plus the record's sha, so it can only change the path on github.com. The REPO constant is fixed. MarkdownText anchors carry rel="noopener noreferrer". Internal links use '#/' or '#id'. The external-link gap is S1 (P2).
W3: default-src 'self' is kept. No remote script, font, image or style origin was added. See S2 (P2) for the hardening.

W4: the only network reads are trace.json and one activity chunk, via a fetch injected into loadTrace and loadActivity. loadActivity refuses any chunk path other than trace/<plan>/<node>/activity.json for a node present in trace.json. A grep over src/web found no localStorage, sessionStorage or document.cookie. The vite /api proxy is dev and preview only and unused in U0b.

W5: git runs through execFileSync with no shell. resolveRef refuses a ref starting with '-'. Every git call is read-only (rev-parse, ls-tree under docs, cat-file, log). The grep found no .claude path read, no http and no fetch in compiler/. The only .claude match is a comment. process.env appears only in vite.config.ts and playwright.config.ts for dev ports, with no secrets. Plan, requirements, harness, activity, loop, verdict and README text all go through read(), which scans every line. A plan path that hits the denylist is not named in the output. The compiler writes only under src/web/public. See S3 (P2).

W6: grep of the packet diff and src/web for local absolute paths, personal emails and keys found no hit. The only ghp_ hit is a documentation line about a runtime-generated fixture token. The github.com/dpmorgandev REPO constant is the public repo owner.

W7: gate.audit (runtime) reports 0 vulnerabilities. gate.audit-dev reports 5 high, attributed in the receipt to the known dev-only braces item (GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm) via stylelint. I couldn't re-run npm audit and rely on the receipt's attribution. This attempt's diff relative to A4 adds no package changes.
W8: loader failures show a plain-text reason (HTTP status, missing file, parse message) in DataNotice and the DataTable error state. No stack trace or server internals are shown.
API8:2023 maps to W3 and W4 and is met. API10:2023 maps to W1 and W8 and is met.
